debounce.behavior: setTimeout reset on every searchInputValue or searchListingState change; prior timer cleared on cleanup

abort_controller.pattern: suggestAbortRef.current.abort() before new fetch; signal passed to fetchSearchSuggest
abort_controller.stale_guard: requestId = ++suggestRequestIdRef; isStaleRequest checks cancelled || aborted || requestId !== current
abort_controller.ignored_responses: Aborted fetches return null; stale requestId skips setState in .then/.finally

cache.on_hit: setSearchSuggestResponse(cached) + setSuggestLoading(false) immediately, then background refetch
cache.on_miss: setSuggestLoading(true); panel may render empty until response
cache.inflight_dedup: dedupeSearchSuggestInflight — same cacheKey shares one Promise

fetch.architecture: SEARCH-SINGLE-ENDPOINT-01 — monolithic suggest; no progressive sidebar/preview split
fetch.product_list_note: GET /products runs on committed keyword (URL state), not on searchInputValue keystrokes

react_state.startTransition: used for product list and navigation; suggest setState is synchronous (not wrapped in startTransition)

render_path.skeleton_when: suggestLoading && group exists but products empty (per-group only)
render_path.empty_loading_gap: Cold cache + no groups: dropdown open but no skeleton or categories for entire backend wait
render_path.category_sidebar: Home.jsx renderCategoryPanel shows categorySuggestions from same response when groups empty

focus_blur.blur: no explicit onBlur on search input in HomeSearch.jsx
focus_blur.mobile_overlay: body scroll lock when isMobile && suggestPanelOpen

race_conditions.fast_typing: Only last debounced query fires; intermediate requests aborted
race_conditions.slow_typing: Each pause >=300ms after min length triggers separate request (e.g. 'đè' then 'đèn hậu')
race_conditions.duplicate_same_key: inflight dedup prevents parallel identical cacheKey requests

react_profiler.reason: Read-only audit; no browser instrumentation run
react_profiler.estimate_basis: Small setState + HomeSearch map over ≤3 groups; not on critical path vs 4000ms backend

mobile_vs_desktop.latency_impact: Same debounce, same endpoint, same cache; mobile may add keyboard dismiss + larger touch target render cost (<5ms estimated)
